column2: [intro]
My name is Loulou, a bit of a fool,
Always ready to liven up every place.
Big theories, they leave me cold,
I’d rather dance, laugh, and let loose in bars.
No need to find deeper meaning,
It’s just for fun, and that's the feeling.
Let’s all vibe together, in the madness of the hours,
I’m here to make you laugh, no stress or powers.
I’ve got a song for you, my friends,
To make you forget all your worries and trends.
In my world, everything’s pink and bright,
We leave our troubles behind, out of sight.
No need to find deeper meaning,
It’s just for fun, and that's the feeling.
Let’s all vibe together, in the madness of the hours,
I’m here to make you laugh, no stress or powers.
